test the waveform_masking function by masking random segments of an audio waveform with zeros
test the spec_augment function by applying frequency and time masking to a spectrogram tensor
test the audio_mixing function by blending two audio samples using a beta-distributed mixing coefficient
test the time_stretch function by stretching or compressing a spectrogram along the time axis at a given rate
build a python module that computes the short-time Fourier transform of an audio signal using JAX
build a python module that reconstructs a time-domain signal from an STFT matrix using inverse STFT
build a python module that computes audio spectrograms from a waveform signal with configurable frame length and power
build a python module that converts spectrograms to Mel-scale with optional log scaling for audio feature extraction
